description.biography:
Average in size, short black hair, pallid, with pitch-black sunken eyes like obsidian that make people look away, and a long scar across his throat from ear to ear. Among people he sits still as carved stone and moves slowly, as if arthritic, until the least hostility brings a cat's speed. His hands wait in his wide black sleeves with a dagger. Elegant in feature, he talks like one raised among beasts, in a low rasp, and only when he must.

Twilight scar: light dims slightly round him wherever he stays over two minutes, recovering once he leaves. Hierarchy Score 3. True Name of Balthazar: Realms of Power: The Infernal p. 34.

Since the last block: 140 xp in Abilities, 160 in Arts, 25 on mastering spells and 5 on a demon's True Name. An imp approached him and he bound it. His Infernal dealings came out and he was Marched; he escaped the Order's assault, probably with Infernal help, and made a new home in a stronger aura (level 4), a season to prepare the lab, 16 seasons of lab work in all. Infernal auras and dealings gave him much Warping.

Combat: dagger Init +1, Attack +5, Defense +3, Damage +4; fist Init +1, Attack +3, Defense +3, Damage +1. Soak +2. Equipment: dagger in a forearm sheath, obsidian pellet.

Familiar: an imp, a lesser Tempter (Maligenii), Infernal Might 10 (Vim), Size -5, kitten-sized with leathery wings, reddish-grey skin and a fanged maw. Int 0, Per +4, Pre -3, Com -1, Str -5, Sta 0, Dex +2, Qik +5. Confidence 1 (3). Keen Vision, Sharp Ears; Greedy, Nocturnal. Cruel +2, Brave -2, Enduring -1, Insidious +3, Sneaking +3. Hierarchy 0. Bite Init +5, Attack +3, Defense +14, Damage -12. Soak 0. Athletics 1, Awareness 5, Bargain 1, Guile 2, Hunt 3, Stealth 5. Powers: Coagulation, Obsession (Hopelessness), Petrification (1 point, Init -10, a stone figurine), See in Darkness, Source of Tranquility (3 points, Init 0, for a Diameter). Weakness: powerless at midday, and turned to stone by direct noon sun until dusk. 2 pawns of Vim in its wings. It came to him offering to watch his back; he bound it with his Perdo Ignem Lab Total. Cords: gold 1, silver 1, bronze 3.

Torus of Fire Protection, a brown fired-clay pendant, 2 pawns. Quench the Open Fire (PeIg 15, Pen +0, unlimited): small fires touching it go out, as do magical flames up to +5 damage; worn over the clothes. Poniard of Deliverance, 2 pawns, remade after the Quaesitores took its like. Appliance of Wrath (PeCo 20, Pen +10, 24/day): flicked in the wrist, it adds a Light Wound on a positive Attack Advantage, armor no bar. Source of Tranquillity, a tiny obsidian winged figurine, 3 pawns. Chamber of Void (PeIg 24, Pen +0, constant): no light at all in the room it is in.

Talisman: the Orb of Immanent Darkness, a black obsidian orb he has always treasured for its cool, 4 pawns to open and 2 for its effect. Attunement: +5 spellcasting involving light's absence. Soothing Shadows (PeIg 14, Pen +0, constant): deep shadow over his head and upper body, so that cloaked and hooded he walks under the day's sun without losing Fatigue, though looking at a sunny land still pains him.

Given away for favors. Arrows of Defeat, six arrows of one charge each from a Lab Total of 40, for a shady noble: Gaping Maw of the Bottomless Pit (PeTe 10, Touch), as Pit of the Gaping Earth where each lands. Sting of the Viper, a human-bone and steel hair pin with a comb, for a woman he fell to, usable by her alone, 2 pawns: The Fool's Fate (PeCo 20, Pen +0, 3/day), a Medium Wound. Rod of Mutilation, a wand of human bone shod in iron, invested for a diabolist who aided his longevity ritual, 6 pawns opened, 4 used, expiring seven years after first use: Crush the Adversary's Limb (PeCo 33, Pen +10, 6/day) breaks the touched limb, healing as a Medium Wound.

This block prints Circular Ward Against Demons at level 20, a General spell whose level the sheet does not hold.

character.summary: Born a Silesian bond-slave, he served an Infernalist master in terrorising eastern Europe until he was as evil as his victims thought him; when the master was Marched he helped the Quaesitores. That left him a sinister husk of a young magus, unable to live with freedom, fit in anywhere, or bear the sun, on the edge of society with his studies, hoping for oblivion. Flambeau in name, he holds to no politics, and his House is not keen to claim him. He has the mind of a cornered beast, a predator wanting peace through his art and no more power than survival needs, and he seems bound for a March as his master was.

description.biography:
Fair hair brushed forward, a plain open face and bright eyes, nearly always smiling. Simple traveling clothes, but bright many-coloured wizard's robes, and always his crwth and bow in a fitted satchel.

Sigil: a moment of calm, like an indrawn breath, before each spell or device takes effect. Voting sigil: a plain, highly polished wooden flute.

He usually carries a handful of mixed vis to give or pay to magi he knows.

Combat: dodge Init +0, Defense +0; fist Init +0, Attack +1, Defense +0, Damage -1; kick Init -1, Attack +1, Defense -1, Damage +2; bludgeon Init -1, Attack +3, Defense +0, Damage +1. Soak +0.

Spell notes: The Magic Flute conjures a flute for as long as he plays it; Heal Thy Broken Voice is a Ritual, under a new CrHe 15 guideline for restoring a made wooden item (p. 139). To Sing of Good Meat and Drink makes a room hungry and thirsty, and he casts it forcelessly so it cannot touch magi. Confound the Rival Singer is level 5 on p. 140, level 4 in every block.

character.summary: Yestin Ap Llewelyn, a travelling bard, an upbeat, friendly dreamer sure that something grander lies just out of reach, who plays for prince, magus and peasant alike across Europe. His magic serves his travels, his music, and the riddles the faerie spirit Taliesin leads him into, where he rights others' wrongs in return for a promise to learn at last the secrets of his bardic lineage. He stays close to his mater, Ffanci ferch Fflam of Jerbiton.
